Theodore Wirth: MOCA/MORC Trails

Opentacky
Heads-up Theo Peeps….. This Friday, September 25th from 4:30pm until done, the MOCA/MORC Trail Crew will be raining destruction with pointy tools on the the north exit of the South West Wirth section to prepare it to be enhanced by the contractor repaving the adjacent paved bike trail. The exit will be torn up for several days until the contractor can complete their work. The goal of this effort is to reduce the amount of gravel that makes its way out onto the paved trail as a result of Skiddy McSkiddingtons getting their skidding thing on as they depart the section. During this disruption, please expect that you may need to carry your bike across the construction area to reduce the likelihood of fall down go boom. We know. Now you do too. Theo for Theo Shout if you have any questions.
Minneapolis, MN
Minnesota Off-Road Cyclists
